name: Scenario
description: Scenario's public generative media API for game-production workflows. Discover custom models, run model-specific image generation, monitor jobs, and find generated assets for characters, environments, items, and UI art.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Scenario API key from your account's API Keys page.

credential_fields.name: api_secret
credential_fields.label: API Secret
credential_fields.description: Scenario API secret paired with the API key.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the Scenario account associated with the supplied API key and secret.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List Scenario foundation and custom models with privacy, type, status, tag, project, and pagination filters.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Get a Scenario model and its current model-specific generation input schema.

tools.name: run_model
tools.description: Run a Scenario model using its documented model-specific parameters. Call get_model first and pass the returned input fields inside parameters.

dryRun.description: Validate the request without starting a paid generation.

parameters.description: Model-specific generation request body obtained from get_model.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the state, progress, errors, and generated asset references for a Scenario generation job.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List generated and uploaded Scenario assets with project and cursor pagination controls.

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Get metadata and delivery URLs for a single Scenario asset.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search Scenario assets using the public asset-search request shape, including project, collection, tag, and generation filters supported by the API.

search_request.description: Scenario asset search request body from the public API reference.
